blockers.note: os-unit generator runs the serve_mode:proxy memory-server as direct-stdio (no port listener) → launchd daemon unreachable. HF-5 writer-count forensics must distinguish the per-session soxe-serve process from the launchd daemon by owner (session vs os-unit) and confirm only one holds the writer lease. Fix is spec-governed (docs/spec/service-lifecycle.md §9).

discovered.note: CRITICAL: esbuild CJS bundle broke import.meta.url → embedding-provider __dirname resolution threw at init → memory-server launchd daemon crash-looped. Fixed in tools/bundle-extension.cjs (import.meta.url shim). Commit e87369e.
CRITICAL: memory_write auto-chunk deadlocked the serial WriteQueue via nested enqueue (any content >chunk_size*4 chars hung forever). Fixed to write chunks directly on writeDb. Commit a4023c3.
memory test-suite stabilization (corrupted auto-chunk test + missing testTimeout; obsolete hash-backend tests; recluster 0-cluster lens marker). Commit a4023c3.
